notes.title: Big update from Luden.io
notes.notes:
Hello all :) Oleg from Luden.io is here. I can't wait to tell you that today our new game Learning Factory finally becomes available. We'll be super happy if you stop by and join us on this adventure of [url=https://blog.luden.io/meet-learning-factory-8d5fd27dac7e]making the best educational game we can[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

Please don't hesitate to drop me a line in [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] or privately via oleg.chumakov@luden.io. I am always happy to talk :)
